A_high_relevance.dose: show only if supported and all required safety data are clear

B_consider.dose: show only if supported and all required safety data are clear

C_potential_benefit.dose: usually reference/range only; never inflate uncertainty

X_professional_review_required.cta: professional review / PRO only when appropriate; BASIC safety warning remains free

supported_range.rule: Can be displayed only when the scenario explicitly supports it.

weight_based_supported_range.rule: Requires valid body weight plus all scenario safety inputs.

reference_intake_only.rule: Must be visually distinguished from a supplement prescription.

no_universal_dose.rule: Explain why Vitami does not invent a dose.

professional_only.rule: Never show a personalized dose in BASIC.

hard_rules: A reference intake (RDA/AI) is never visually labeled as 'your dose'.
An UL is never presented as a target.
If required data are missing, replace the final card with a follow-up question request.
If an X safety override exists, suppress any positive dose recommendation for that supplement.
Do not show a commercial product or price in BASIC until pharmacy mapping is intentionally enabled.
